hoardeye.search.title: Storage Search
hoardeye.search.empty_world: Nothing here yet! Open your chests, barrels and shulker boxes, and Hoard Eye will remember what's inside.
hoardeye.search.select_item: Select an item to see where it is.
hoardeye.search.select_container: Select a container to see what's inside.
hoardeye.search.hint_items: Click a location to walk there · Double-click an item to highlight all · ↑↓ and Enter work too
hoardeye.search.hint_containers: Double-click a container to walk there · Hover items for details · ↑↓ and Enter work too
hoardeye.search.sort.name: Name
hoardeye.config.title: Hoard Eye Settings
hoardeye.config.tab.label: Label
hoardeye.config.enabled.desc: Turns all of Hoard Eye on or off. What it remembers is kept either way.
hoardeye.config.remember.desc: Record names and contents when you open or place containers. Turn off to stop learning new ones (what's already known still shows).
hoardeye.config.forget_broken.desc: When a container you know is broken or picked up, forget it. Turn off to keep its last contents in search.
hoardeye.config.show_names.desc: Show a container's custom name (from an anvil).
hoardeye.config.show_contents.desc: Show the items inside as icons.
hoardeye.config.show_unknown_hint.desc: For containers you haven't opened yet, show "open once to remember".
hoardeye.config.shulker_tooltip.desc: Hovering a shulker box item shows its contents as a 9×3 grid of icons instead of a text list.
hoardeye.config.shulker_shift.desc: Show the grid only while Shift is held; otherwise the normal text list.
hoardeye.config.position.desc: Where on screen the label goes.
hoardeye.config.y_offset.desc: How far the label sits from the crosshair or screen edge.
hoardeye.config.max_icons.desc: Most different items shown; the rest become "+N".
hoardeye.config.icons_per_row.desc: Wrap to a new row after this many icons.
hoardeye.config.show_more.desc: Show how many more kinds there are when they don't all fit.
hoardeye.config.count_format.desc: Short ("1.7k") or exact ("1728") totals under the icons.
hoardeye.config.background.desc: Draw a dark panel behind the label so it's readable on bright blocks.
hoardeye.config.background_opacity.desc: How dark the panel behind the label is.
hoardeye.config.max_distance.desc: Only show the label for containers within this distance.
hoardeye.config.hide_sneaking.desc: Hide the label while you're sneaking (handy when it's in the way).
hoardeye.config.containers_note: Choose which containers get a label when you look at them. Hidden ones are still remembered and searchable.
hoardeye.config.show_all.desc: Turn labels on for every container type.
hoardeye.config.hide_all.desc: Turn labels off for every container type.
hoardeye.config.kind.desc: Show the label when looking at a %s.
hoardeye.config.search_note: Open Storage Search with Y (change it in Options → Controls → Key Binds → Hoard Eye). Click a result to have the locator walk you there.
hoardeye.config.locator_beam.desc: A tall line above each container you're being guided to. It's hidden by walls like normal blocks; the waypoint markers aren't.
hoardeye.config.locator_reach.desc: How close you need to get for a container to count as found and stop being marked.
hoardeye.config.strip_position.desc: Where the arrow and distance strip goes.
hoardeye.config.check_updates.desc: When a newer version is out on GitHub it downloads in the background, is checked, and goes in when you close the game. Nothing to click.
hoardeye.config.found_sound.desc: Play a sound as you reach each container.
hoardeye.config.data_note: Hoard Eye's memory is saved in config/hoardeye.json, separately for each server and world.
hoardeye.config.forget_world.desc: Forget every container remembered on the server or world you're in.
hoardeye.config.forget_world.confirm: Forget every container remembered on this server or world? You'll need to open them again.
hoardeye.config.forget_all.desc: Forget every container on every server and world.
hoardeye.config.forget_all.confirm: Forget every container on every server and world? This can't be undone.
hoardeye.config.open_folder.desc: Open the folder with Hoard Eye's files.
hoardeye.config.locator_markers.desc: Show each container you're looking for as an icon with its distance on screen, visible through walls. When it's behind you or off-screen, the marker sits at the edge with an arrow pointing the way.
hoardeye.fetch.add.tooltip: Add a stack of this to your fetch list (%s items on it now). See it under View: Fetch list.
hoardeye.fetch.empty: Your fetch list is empty. In the Items view, select something and press + Fetch to add a stack of it.
hoardeye.fetch.route_empty: Add items to plan a route through your containers, nearest first.
hoardeye.fetch.hint: −/+ a stack · Start route walks you to each container and shows what to take
hoardeye.fetch.imported: From %s: the materials you need. Start the route to collect them.
key.hoardeye.pick_box: Pick items from a shulker box
hoardeye.config.box_picker_speed.desc: How fast the box picker works, compared with the fastest a person could do it by hand. If items get left behind, slow it down.
hoardeye.config.box_picker_instant.desc: Ignore the speed and send everything at once. Fastest possible, but servers may not keep up with it, so it's off by default.
hoardeye.config.box_picker.desc: Middle-click a shulker box (or press its key) in any container or your inventory to choose what to take. The box goes back by itself.
hoardeye.picker.tooltip: Middle-click or %s: pick what to take
hoardeye.picker.safe: Box stays put until you press Take.
hoardeye.picker.no_pick: No pickaxe: 3s to break the box.
hoardeye.picker.no_spot: No room to set the box down here.
hoardeye.picker.no_room: Not enough room in your inventory.
hoardeye.picker.cursor: Put down what you're holding first.
hoardeye.picker.box_changed: That box moved or changed, so the picker closed.
hoardeye.grab.not_confirmed: The box wouldn't go back, so it's in your inventory.
hoardeye.grab.burst_failed: The instant way didn't work here, so the box picker will go step by step until you reconnect. Pick again.
hoardeye.grab.no_room: No room in your inventory to take the box out. Nothing changed.
hoardeye.grab.died: You died while getting items, so it stopped. Check where you died for the box.
hoardeye.grab.left_box: You moved too far away, so it stopped. The box is still at %s.
hoardeye.grab.not_broken: The box wouldn't break, so it's still at %s.
hoardeye.grab.left_drop: Couldn't reach the dropped box. It's on the ground near %s.
hoardeye.grab.box_gone: The box is gone: someone or something picked it up near %s.
hoardeye.grab.not_taken_out: The server didn't let the box move.
hoardeye.grab.no_spot: The box couldn't be set down, so nothing came out.
hoardeye.grab.not_opened: The box wouldn't open, so it was picked back up.
hoardeye.grab.not_reopened: Couldn't reopen the chest, so the box is in your inventory.
hoardeye.grab.chest_full: The chest is full now, so the box is in your inventory.
hoardeye.grab.box_kept: The box is in your inventory: this container can't be reopened by itself.
